from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A — House rent allowance (old regime only)
RENT_EXCESS_PERCENT = Decimal('0.10')  # Sec 10(13A)(b): 10% of salary
HRA_METRO_PERCENT = Decimal('0.50')     # Sec 10(13A)(c): 50% for metro cities
HRA_NON_METRO_PERCENT = Decimal('0.40') # Sec 10(13A)(c): 40% for non-metro cities

# Sec 16(ia) — Standard deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')   # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')   # Sec 115BAC proviso

# Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A) — Interest on loan for a self-occupied house (old regime only)
MAX_SELF_OCCUPIED_INTEREST = Decimal('200000') # Sec 24(b)

# Sec 80C read with Sec 80CCE — Investments (old regime only)
MAX_80C = Decimal('150000')            # Sec 80C

# Sec 80CCD(1B) — Additional NPS contribution (old regime only)
MAX_80CCD_1B = Decimal('50000')        # Sec 80CCD(1B)

# Sec 80D — Health insurance premium (old regime only)
MAX_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000') # Sec 80D(2)(a)
MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')     # Sec 80D(2)(a) proviso
MAX_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000') # Sec 80D(2)(b)
MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')     # Sec 80D(2)(b) proviso

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A — Old regime tax slabs: list of (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 115BAC — New tax regime tax slabs (same for all ages)
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('400000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('400000'), Decimal('800000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('800000'), Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('2400000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('2400000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 87A — Rebate for resident individuals
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal('500000')
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal('12500')
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal('1200000')
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal('60000')

# First Schedule — Surcharge thresholds and rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD = [
    (Decimal('5000000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('10000000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('20000000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('50000000'), Decimal('0.37')),
]
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('5000000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('10000000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('20000000'), Decimal('0.25')),
]

# Health and Education Cess
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
    """
    Sec 288A / 288B rounding:
    First floor to whole rupees, then round to the nearest multiple of 10.
    Returns (rounded_amount, adjustment_amount).
    """
    floored = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    # Custom round to nearest ten: last digit >= 5 rounds up, else down.
    rem = floored % Decimal('10')
    if rem >= Decimal('5'):
        rounded = floored + (Decimal('10') - rem)
    else:
        rounded = floored - rem
    adjustment = rounded - amount
    return rounded, adjustment


def compute_slabs(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal('0')
    breakdown = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            break
        if upper is None:
            taxable_in_band = taxable_income - lower
        else:
            taxable_in_band = min(taxable_income, upper) - lower
        
        band_tax = taxable_in_band * rate
        total_tax += band_tax
        if upper is None:
            desc = f"Income above {lower}"
        else:
            desc = f"Income between {lower} and {upper}"
        breakdown.append((desc, band_tax))
    return total_tax, breakdown


def get_surcharge_rate(income: Decimal, thresholds: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal]]) -> Decimal:
    rate = Decimal('0')
    for threshold, r in thresholds:
        if income > threshold:
            rate = r
    return rate


def run_regime(inp: dict, is_new: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp['gross_salary']))
    age = inp['age']
    trace = []

    # 1. Salary / Gross Salary
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    # 2. Deductions from salary
    if is_new:
        std_dedn = min(gross_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_NEW)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_dedn),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC"
        })
        net_salary = gross_salary - std_dedn
        hp_loss = Decimal('0')
        gti = max(Decimal('0'), net_salary - hp_loss)
        ch_via = Decimal('0')
    else:
        std_dedn = min(gross_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_OLD)
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Standard deduction",
            "amount": str(-std_dedn),
            "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
        })
        net_salary = gross_salary - std_dedn

        # HRA Exemption
        hra_received = Decimal(str(inp['hra_received']))
        basic_da = Decimal(str(inp['basic_plus_da']))
        rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp['rent_paid']))
        is_metro = inp['rent_city_is_metro']

        if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
            exc_rent = max(Decimal('0'), rent_paid - (basic_da * RENT_EXCESS_PERCENT))
            pct = HRA_METRO_PERCENT if is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_PERCENT
            city_limit = basic_da * pct
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, exc_rent, city_limit)
        else:
            hra_exempt = Decimal('0')

        if hra_exempt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "HRA exemption",
                "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"
            })
            net_salary -= hra_exempt

        # House Property Loss (Self-occupied interest)
        home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp['home_loan_interest']))
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, MAX_SELF_OCCUPIED_INTEREST)
        if hp_loss > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
            })

        gti = max(Decimal('0'), net_salary - hp_loss)

        # Chapter VI-A Deductions
        sec_80c = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80c'])), MAX_80C)
        if sec_80c > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-sec_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })

        sec_80ccd_1b = min(Decimal(str(inp['sec_80ccd_1b'])), MAX_80CCD_1B)
        if sec_80ccd_1b > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-sec_80ccd_1b),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Section 80D
        health_self = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_self']))
        self_senior = age >= 60
        max_self_80d = MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR if self_senior else MAX_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR
        ded_self = min(health_self, max_self_80d)

        health_parents = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_parents']))
        parents_senior = inp['parents_senior']
        max_parents_80d = MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else MAX_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR
        ded_parents = min(health_parents, max_parents_80d)

        sec_80d_total = ded_self + ded_parents
        if sec_80d_total > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (health insurance)",
                "amount": str(-sec_80d_total),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        ch_via = sec_80c + sec_80ccd_1b + sec_80d_total
        # Sec 80A(2) overall cap
        ch_via = min(ch_via, gti)
        if ch_via > 0 and (sec_80c + sec_80ccd_1b + sec_80d_total) > gti:
            # We already traced the individual items, but if capped, we adjust or let GTI handle it?
            # Sec 80A(2) says total deductions cannot exceed GTI. If individual items were traced,
            # their sum is ch_via.
            pass

    # Total Income before Sec 288A
    total_income_unrounded = max(Decimal('0'), gti - ch_via)

    # Sec 288A Rounding of total income
    total_income_rounded, inc_adjustment = round_nearest_ten(total_income_unrounded)
    if inc_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
            "amount": str(inc_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    # Tax Slabs
    if is_new:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60

    tax_before_rebate, slab_breakdown = compute_slabs(total_income_rounded, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_breakdown:
        if amt > 0:
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": f"Income tax on {desc.lower()}",
                "amount": str(amt),
                "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A" if not is_new else "Sec 115BAC"
            })

    current_tax = tax_before_rebate

    # Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal('0')
    if is_new:
        if total_income_rounded <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        elif total_income_rounded > REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            # Marginal relief (new regime only)
            excess_income = total_income_rounded - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            tax_without_relief = current_tax
            if tax_without_relief > excess_income:
                possible_rebate = tax_without_relief - excess_income
                rebate = min(current_tax, possible_rebate)
    else:
        if total_income_rounded <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })
        current_tax -= rebate

    # Surcharge and Marginal Relief
    surcharge_thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(total_income_rounded, surcharge_thresholds)
    surcharge_amount = current_tax * surcharge_rate

    if surcharge_amount > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {surcharge_rate * 100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge_amount),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

        # Surcharge marginal relief check
        # Check against each applicable threshold
        for threshold, rate in surcharge_thresholds:
            if total_income_rounded > threshold:
                tax_at_thresh, _ = compute_slabs(threshold, slabs)
                # Rebate does not apply above threshold typically, but compute basic tax at threshold
                surcharge_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * rate
                total_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh + surcharge_at_thresh
                excess_income = total_income_rounded - threshold
                max_tax_allowed = total_at_thresh + excess_income
                actual_tax_plus_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge_amount
                if actual_tax_plus_surcharge > max_tax_allowed:
                    surcharge_relief = actual_tax_plus_surcharge - max_tax_allowed
                    surcharge_amount -= surcharge_relief
                    trace.append({
                        "kind": "tax",
                        "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
                        "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                        "clause": "First Schedule / Surcharge Marginal Relief"
                    })
                break

    tax_plus_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge_amount

    # Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and education cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    total_tax_unrounded = tax_plus_surcharge + cess

    # Sec 288B Rounding of tax
    tax_payable, tax_adjustment = round_nearest_ten(total_tax_unrounded)
    if tax_adjustment != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_adjustment),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income_rounded),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = run_regime(inp, is_new=False)
    new_result = run_regime(inp, is_new=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
